script: Write-Host '=== Push body.glb via fresh full clone ==='; $tmp='C:/work/2026/Claude/_bodypush'; if (Test-Path $tmp) { Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force }; Write-Host '--- clone ---'; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zhangtianhai2017/Test-.git $tmp 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; Push-Location $tmp; Write-Host '--- branch ---'; git checkout --orphan claude-temp-body 2>&1; git rm -rf . 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3; Copy-Item 'C:/work/2026/Claude/test-/body.glb' 'body.glb' -Force; Write-Host ("body.glb size: " + (Get-Item body.glb).Length); Write-Host '--- commit ---'; git -c user.email='windows@local' -c user.name='windows' add body.glb; git -c user.email='windows@local' -c user.name='windows' commit -m 'temp: body.glb for Linux bake' 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; Write-Host '--- push ---'; git push -u origin claude-temp-body --force 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 10; git rev-parse HEAD; Pop-Location; Write-Host '=== done ==='
